intro: This is my personal corner of the web. For the work I do, the software I build, and the ideas behind it, there’s a professional side, too.

children.text: Here on my .com site, I’m following the things that spark my curiosity: software in an AI era, DIY solar, hydroponics, aquascapes, and a life of faith.
It’s a place for experiments, observations, and reflections as things take shape. There’s always another question to follow.
JeremyZoerman.dev is home to my software engineering work: my background, projects, and writing about building useful software.
If you’re looking for what I do professionally, what I’m building, or how I approach engineering, that’s the place to start.
